title: Card Spirit
profTagline: One card fills the screen and its spirit speaks: sober advice for today from each of the 78 Rider-Waite cards.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home screen.
spiritFail: The spirit is silent. Check your connection.
spiritGenerated: The spirit's words are composed by a model from the card's meaning; the card and its meaning are canonical.
